info.title: Restaurant API
info.description: Local restaurant catalogue, private web reservations, tenant-scoped staff sessions and read-only chat.

get.summary: Read backend payment capability for an active chat session
get.description: Active tenant/session cookie required. Rejects cross-site reads and foreign Origin; same-origin GET may omit Origin. Returns paymentsEnabled true only when PAYMENTS_ENABLED is active and both MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY and MIDTRANS_SIGNATURE_SECRET are configured; exposes no secret values or diagnostics, and does not check credential validity or provider readiness. Unset flag preserves enabled local behavior; staging explicitly enables sandbox and requires both mounted secret files. Missing credentials reject create and notification with HTTP 503 before session, database or provider access. Disabled create and notification return HTTP 503 with error.code PAYMENTS_DISABLED before session, database or provider access. Existing order status reads remain tenant/session-scoped.

200.description: Backend capability, not proof provider is ready

post.summary: Finalize a confirmed reservation as owner or staff
post.description: Trusted Origin and JSON required. Tenant and actor come from active staff session, revalidated inside transaction. completed and no_show require server time strictly after endAt; exact boundary rejects. Staff cancellation has no customer cutoff. UUID key durably identifies event; identical normalized payload, actor and reservation replay same receipt. Changed operation/payload/actor/resource or different key on terminal reservation returns 409. Missing or foreign reservation returns 404. Status and event commit atomically. Rate limit: 60 valid attempts per actor per minute per process.

200.description: Committed or replayed minimized event receipt

403.description: Role, Origin or content type rejected

503.description: Uncertain dependency failure; retain original key and payload

get.summary: Read tenant operational and reservation activity
get.description: Read-only owner/staff feed from one RepeatableRead snapshot. Newest timestamp first, source ascending then ID descending. Operational actions allowlisted; no target IDs invented. Customer and system reservation events included with actor type. No guest/contact/account name/reason/payload/token fields. Strict single page parameter; unknown parameters rejected.

200.description: Bounded activity page

get.summary: Check availability for one visit without holding a table
get.description: Exactly date, time and partySize are required once each. Unknown and repeated query parameters are rejected. The server resolves active tenant and exactly one active outlet; no private booking data is returned. Unsupported policy or unavailable storage fails closed.

parameters.name: partySize
parameters.description: Canonical decimal string from 1 to 12; no leading zero, whitespace, exponent or fraction.

200.description: Point-in-time availability, never a hold or booking; no internal identifiers or customer data.
